claims.claim: Infleqtion's September 24 Form 8-K reports an issuer demonstration of 30 entangled logical qubits on Sqale, which is evidence of technical milestone progress but does not by itself establish independent verification, customer economics, fault-tolerant utility, or scalable commercial deployment.

The September 24 disclosure was furnished under Item 7.01 rather than filed for Section 18 liability, so Alpha should preserve a source-quality distinction between the issuer-reported milestone and independently corroborated commercial or technical validation.

risks.risk: A demonstrated logical-qubit milestone can reduce technical uncertainty without proving economic quantum advantage, repeatable customer utility, or scalable revenue conversion.
Issuer-furnished milestone evidence remains source-dependent until independently corroborated; this is a confidence constraint, not evidence that the milestone is false.

contradictions.contradiction: The prior Beta unknown that the targeted 30 logical qubits had not yet been demonstrated is partially resolved by the September 24 issuer disclosure, while independent verification and customer economics remain open.
contradictions.disposition: update uncertainty rather than treat the prior technical target as an active blocker

unknowns.unknown: Independent replication or third-party validation of the 30-entangled-logical-qubit result remains open in the evidence set.
Customer economics and repeatable workload advantage from the demonstrated configuration remain open and belong to Alpha underwriting when quantified.
